notes: V7.1.4: drag-to-reorder bot tabs (Chrome-style; OVERVIEW and MORE BOTS stay pinned). Overview now has a sort dropdown — order bot blocks by portfolio, total profit, day P/L $, day P/L %, win rate, or # of positions. The choice persists across restarts. Tab reorder also persists to the bot registry, so the new order survives a restart. Also tests the new notify-only updater from v1.1.3.
